notes: Fix desktop browsers incorrectly receiving mobile one-handed Essentials navigation when the window is narrow, zoomed, or uses touch support. Mobile view now requires touch-first mobile input, while real phones and tablets retain mobile gestures, bottom navigation and responsive layout. All v3.5.65 functionality is retained and Photo Booth remains removed.

items: Desktop viewport width alone no longer enables the mobile layout.
Touchscreen Windows and Linux desktop browsers keep the desktop Essentials menu.
Mobile navigation activates only on mobile OS/touch-first devices with mobile-sized viewports, including phone landscape.
The dock and mobile window-sizing logic use the same corrected detector.
Changing screen dimensions can switch layouts through existing event-based resize handling; no new timers.
Mobile Gesture Controls, one-handed bottom navigation (on phones), and Outfit Lock System.
Smart Library Merge, crafting replacement, three-color harmonizer, Photo Booth removed.
R132/R133 compatibility code and floating dock black-space safety.
JavaScript syntax and simulated browser desktop/mobile detection and regression tests passed. Live Bondage Club not tested.
